horoscope: With the Sun and Neptune in opposition today, dear Aries, you may not be seeing people plainly and situations realistically. It's even more possible that others aren't seeing you correctly, and you should try your best not to encourage it, as tempting as it may be to avoid present discomfort, since it ultimately works against you. You may want to escape if someone seems to be pressuring you for a definite response or commitment. Since it's far better to attach yourself to dreams that inspire you than those that let you down, don't be afraid of holes you might see in your current plans and visions. This transit tends to spotlight unrealized needs, dreams, and wishes. However, as the day advances, with a Sun-Pluto trine in play, better relationships can be a powerful motivator for self-improvement. Counseling, organizing, negotiating, and networking can be in focus. We're heading toward a Full Moon in your sign, and emotions run high. You may very well have an epiphany or intense realization now.

Today’s annual opposition between the Sun and Neptune can temporarily confuse matters, dear Taurus. Your interest in work and health runs high these days as the Sun transits your solar sixth house, but this week you may struggle to find a healthy balance between work and rest, or between physical and mental/emotional health. Today, disappointment or misjudgment may come up, and your energy levels may fluctuate until you find a healthy middle. You may need to tame some of your expectations and temper your energy to get there. Today’s transits remind you to respect rather than challenge your natural body energy rhythms. You could also recognize the need for more inspiration to help refuel you. As the day advances, you may be sorting out tricky emotional matters and problems. You can be especially resourceful right now, making the most of the least, or the most of what you have. The goal now is to be productive and satisfied with what you've accomplished.

This is a generally strong time for creative, expressive, and romantic pursuits, dear Gemini, but there can be some challenges and ups and downs involved. A Sun-Neptune opposition is a yearly event that reminds you to work on your expectations. It also asks you to pay more attention to your valid needs to dream, imagine, and believe, especially in your social life this year. You may be questioning an uncertain or ambiguous situation in a friendship, or you could be longing for a kindred-spirit connection. It's not a time when we see things clearly, so it's better to wait out important matters. If you're temporarily uninspired, you might benefit from taking a small break to refresh yourself. Today is not ideal for opening your heart or for taking a risk or gamble. It's a time to slow down and catch your breath and trust that this is for the best! As the day advances, a Sun-Pluto transit comes into play, and you're drawn to purposeful activities. You can feel more passionate about your personal interests, hobbies, or romantic life. You are likely to enjoy pleasantly strong feelings, and perhaps even a breakthrough in a relationship.

With the Sun opposite Neptune today, dear Cancer, you can feel vulnerable to ups and downs related to reputation, career matters, or family and living conditions. You may not know where you stand on an issue or where you’re heading, and this uncertainty can undermine your motivation. Someone in your life may not be on board with your goals, or you may lack clear goals. You’re sensitive about your reputation, and ambiguities about your long-term plans or career can affect your enjoyment of home life. You might struggle with your intuition, unsure whether to trust it, which makes decision-making uncertain. In truth, your living conditions, relationship with family, and personal life are strengthening this month, and the current emotional dip reminds you to adjust your expectations, dreams, and goals to better match your current situation. Your search for more meaning is ongoing, and you’re bound to deal with speed bumps along the way. As the day advances, we head toward a Sun-Pluto trine, and you're ready to tackle a problem from the root. You're looking for the hidden message or agenda, and you're drawn to projects and activities that have longevity or special meaning. Emotional "renovations" are satisfying. Healing activities with family or at home are favored.

There can be some confusion, disappointment, or simply a temporary questioning of motivation today, dear Leo, and for you, it is likely to revolve around communications, transportation, projects, and learning. Be a little more vigilant if working with facts and figures, and watch that you don't communicate in a way that is easily misinterpreted. Dream and create, but be cautious with practical matters. If someone is trying to get a commitment or definite answer from you, and it doesn't feel totally right, try to politely defer it to a more confident time. Even so, it's a strong day for creative visions. A Sun-Pluto trine comes into play, and you might be reorganizing your work, projects, studies, and communications equipment. Discussions with a partner, counselor, or good friend can be helpful and might even lead to improvements that are life-changing. With Pluto, even the easy aspects can bring up slightly uncomfortable ideas or truths, but the harmonious aspects do make them easier to swallow. This is a time to consider ways to change your life for the better, especially by communicating more authentically.

There has been a stronger focus on the material and physical world these days, dear Virgo, with the Sun’s transit of your solar second house. However, with today’s transits, your experiences may illuminate some level of spiritual discontent. Confusion may arise around financial or intimate matters as the Sun forms opposition with Neptune. You might face a situation where you must draw boundaries with others who drain your time or energy. This yearly transit reminds you to pay more attention to your spiritual and emotional needs. On a practical level, avoid making larger purchases and lending or borrowing, for now, until you see things more clearly. If you're unsure about someone’s intentions, it’s not the time to push for problem-solving, but it’s a good time to examine your needs. Look for areas of life where your expectations may be so high that they put undue pressure on you or your relationships. However, a Sun-Pluto transit is also in play, and you can feel comfortably ambitious, especially as the day advances. good energy is with you for nurturing your desires to build and grow a business or project. Look for hidden gems and gold mines now. Self-improvement is in focus, particularly relating to your attitude towards your talents, money, work, and health.

Transits these days tend to raise your spirits, in general, dear Libra, and it's a special time for advancing your personal interests. However, a Sun-Neptune opposition today can deflate you until you understand its purpose. You may be swinging from idealistic images of someone or a situation to imagining the worst. For best results, focus on the things you love instead of pinning your hopes elsewhere. If you are unprepared or disorganized, any drama occurring now can feel worse than it is. Recognize that you are more sensitive emotionally, spiritually, and physically right now, and do your best to take a break from overdoing it or overthinking. You may very well discover a strong need to connect with something special to find more meaning in your life. Blending this with your recent focus on physical concerns will be ideal. Don't push yourself or a situation, and you'll be in fine shape now. The Sun is also moving into harmony with Pluto, reminding you that improving your life often means making important internal changes. It's a strong influence for getting yourself into an empowered situation and mindset. You are more able to see what needs adjusting, and possibly what needs to be left behind, to feel stronger moving forward. Creative activities are well favored.

There can be some lack of clarity to deal with today, dear Scorpio, particularly related to what is expected of you and what you expect from others. Work and service are in strong focus, but routine matters can be difficult if you're not feeling motivated or directed. A lot is going on behind the scenes, and you may not always feel on top of your game because of this general distraction. While energy levels are less than ideal, personal attraction and emotional stimulation are strong now. Your intuition is highly stimulated, and increased compassion may motivate you to help someone or provide a service. While attractions are strong today, some level of confusion is likely, and it can be difficult to accurately "read" people in your life at the moment. Similarly, while you might envision an exciting project today, it can be difficult knowing how to get it off the ground. Still, the Sun also approaches a harmonious aspect with Pluto, which is powerful for emotional regeneration and recognizing its value. It's also good for letting go of something that's no longer needed in your life. You might benefit from reorganizing or paring down around home, and feel great about doing so. You're able to see what should stay and what should go. It's really about knowing what you can do without, and working on emotional baggage is also recommended.

Your dreams, hopes, and social life are often in positive focus these days, dear Sagittarius. However, with the Sun opposing Neptune today, you may be reminded of specific unrealized dreams, which can temporarily deflate you. This annual event seems to spotlight what’s missing in your life, yet it may be hard to pinpoint, leading to vague discontent. You might experience some confusion in your relationships, desires, and attractions until you sort things out. The tendency is to see-saw between fantasy and reality until you find a middle ground. Romance or affectionate feelings can be draining today if you don’t know where you stand. Accepting that you may not truly need to know for the time being can be empowering, however. You might benefit from taking a break to clear your head and perhaps seek new sources of inspiration. Look for the beauty in your life in the present for best results now, but don’t dismiss yearnings altogether–they may very well point you in the right direction with some moderation and common sense in the mix. Helping with this is a Sun-Pluto trine that positions you well to put something to rest that is no longer serving your needs to grow, evolve, and thrive. Overall, the day is filled with exciting but chaotic energy as we head toward a Full Moon. Imagination is powerful, and maybe going a little too far temporarily, and mixed signals can abound.

While this is a generally strong time for meeting your responsibilities and pursuing your goals, dear Capricorn, there can be a temporary dip today. A Sun-Neptune opposition can remind you to align your goals with your current dreams, or to pay more attention to your need for extra magic, imagination, or spirituality if you've been ignoring these drives. This can feel slightly disorienting or confusing, but going with the flow and accepting that you may not need to know everything right now can help. Ambiguities around living conditions or arrangements, family, or insecurities about your capabilities seem more prominent today, affecting your pursuit of goals, career, or responsibilities. However, taking a breather to reconnect with your intuition on these matters can help redirect you. You might find new and improved sources of inspiration in the process. Helping you find your center is a Sun-Pluto trine that encourages you to see your priorities. This transit falls along your career, talents, money, and reputation sectors. You can completely transform a difficult situation into an opportunity to grow and improve. There can be financial gains, a chance to showcase your talents, or increased ambition to improve your financial picture. It's your determination to overcome obstacles that gets you places now.

Today's Sun-Neptune opposition can temporarily throw a veil over your perceptions, dear Aquarius, and you might question what to believe or have a difficult time focusing. Misinformation may be circulating, and you may get stuck in looping conversations that don’t really get you where you want to go mentally. Be careful not to commit or speak too soon or officially on a matter until the fog clears and you are certain of the facts. This transit can serve to spotlight your unrealized dreams or areas of discontent. A temporary lack of direction or inspiration can leave you especially sensitive to distractions, making it hard to get things done. However, it’s a good time to reconsider or examine your expectations. Expectations can sometimes spoil perfectly good moments, so do your best to keep things realistic. However, if you’ve been ignoring your need for inspiration and happiness goals, now is the time to give them some attention. Try to make peace with the idea that you can't read a person or situation right now, and try to tap into the divine energy of the Sun-Pluto trine that's also in play. It's strong for making renovations—deep, lasting changes that refresh your life —and this isn't only about cosmetic changes. Emotional renovations include getting rid of bad habits, situations, and attitudes. This is also a good time to take a chance or two through learning and exploring beyond your usual bounds.

The Moon spends another day in your sign, dear Pisces, and your emotional world is a little more colorful than usual! With the Sun opposite Neptune today, be careful about investing time, resources, and energy in uncertain endeavors. With your ownership and resource sectors involved, it's especially vital to avoid significant financial transactions. A financial or ownership matter may be up in the air for now. In relationships, boundaries are unclear. Watch out for clinging to a false, idealized image of a person, project, or relationship. Uncertainty about your means and resources can also affect your relationships now. Wait things out rather than pushing for clarity and resolve to pay more attention to your spiritual needs while protecting your material ones. Tap into your more imaginative side today when it's appropriate to do so! The full picture may not be available to you, but as the day advances, you may be drawn to situations that help you grow and change, whether you're aware of it or not. Opportunities may arise to heal and reinvigorate yourself, especially through some solitude or peace. This can be a strong time to quit a bad habit or put something behind you that empowers you in the long term. You can more easily identify the impulses and desires that serve you well and distinguish them from those that are destructive.
